periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the patches are oriented roughly 15 to 20 degrees inward at the superior poles relative to the vertical facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with a vertical height significantly exceeding the horizontal width, approximately a 1.7:1 ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patches exhibit a distinct downward tapering, with the geometric center positioned higher than the midpoint of the vertical axis due to the elongated inferior tail.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 35-40% of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely set, with a lateral separation approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular convex profiles with no visible flattening at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow soilage/discoloration of the ventral and abdominal fur relative to the high-white cranial fur.
